# Templates

Templates are written `{{<source>.<name>.<field>}}` (dot notation). They are resolved in a repo's `env:` and a service's `env:`, when Pomelo writes the env files and starts the service; every other value (`cmd`, `environments` URLs, shared service `environment:`) is used as written. A token the resolver does not know stays in the output as written, so a typo shows up in the env file instead of becoming an empty value. A `| filter` after the key is accepted but changes nothing.

Database name templates (`databases:` and a repo's `shared_services: [{ <name>: { db_name: ... } }]`) take only the `branch` tokens; they also accept the older spellings `{{branch_safe}}` and `{{branch|safe}}` (and the same for `hash` and `host`), but write `{{branch.safe}}`.

In a `cmd`, use `$PORT` (the service's leased port), `$BIND_IP` or any env var the service gets; a `cmd` shared service gets `$PORT` and `$BIND_IP` too.

## Tokens

Examples are for branch `feat/login` of project `myproject`.

| Token | Resolves to | Example | In database names |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{{shared.<name>.url}}` | The shared service's connection: `user:pass@host:port`, or `host:port` for one with no login (Redis, for example). For a `cmd` shared service, `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`. `{{shared.<name>}}` is the same. | `postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432` | - |
| `{{shared.<name>.host}}` | Always `127.0.0.1`: `localhost` can resolve to `::1`, which Docker's published ports miss. | `127.0.0.1` | - |
| `{{shared.<name>.port}}` | The shared service's leased port (plus the instance number when `capacity` runs several). | `5432` | - |
| `{{shared.<name>.user}}` | The login from `db_user` (`postgres` for a Postgres that sets none; empty otherwise). | `postgres` | - |
| `{{shared.<name>.pass}}` | The password from `db_password` (`postgres` for a Postgres that sets none; empty otherwise). | `postgres` | - |
| `{{shared.<name>.slot}}` | This workspace's slot on a `capacity` service, from 0 (a Redis database number, for example); 0 when the service has none. | `3` | - |
| `{{slot.<name>}}` | Same as `{{shared.<name>.slot}}`. | `3` | - |
| `{{db.<name>}}` | The name of one of the repo's `databases`: session prefix plus the resolved name template. | `myproject_feat_login` | - |
| `{{db.<name>.url}}` | `postgres://user:pass@host:port/<database>` through the shared Postgres. | `postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/myproject_feat_login` | - |
| `{{<repo>.<service>.url}}` | The service's URL through the dev proxy, `http://<service>.<repo>.<branch>.localhost:<proxy port>`; or the remote URL when the active `environments` profile lists `<repo>.<service>`. `<repo>` is the alias or the folder name, and `{{<repo>.<service>}}` is the same. A branch that starts with a ticket key uses just the key in the host: `proj-101-login` gives `server.api.proj-101.localhost`. | `http://server.api.feat-login.localhost:8767` | - |
| `{{<repo>.<service>.path}}` | The same-origin dev proxy path, `/_pom_dev/<repo>/<service>`, for a frontend calling its API without CORS. | `/_pom_dev/api/server` | - |
| `{{<repo>.<service>.host}}` | The host part of the service's URL. | `server.api.feat-login.localhost` | - |
| `{{<repo>.<service>.port}}` | The service's leased port (the remote URL's port under a profile). | `41000` | - |
| `{{<repo>.<service>.ws}}` | The service's URL with `ws://` (or `wss://`) for websockets. | `ws://server.api.feat-login.localhost:8767` | - |
| `{{secret.<NAME>}}` | A value from the project's secrets store, read when env is written. Never put a secret in `pom.yml`. | `sk_test_123` | - |
| `{{branch}}` | The workspace's branch, as is. | `feat/login` | yes |
| `{{branch.safe}}` | The branch with `/` turned into `_`; hyphens are kept: `feat/login-form` gives `feat_login-form`. | `feat_login` | yes |
| `{{branch.host}}` | The branch as a DNS label: lowercase, other characters turned into `-`, at most 63 bytes (a hash suffix keeps long names apart). | `feat-login` | yes |
| `{{branch.hash}}` | The first 8 hex digits of the branch's SHA-1. | `5d5c6df1` | yes |
| `{{bind_ip}}` | Always `127.0.0.1`. | `127.0.0.1` | - |

## Removed colon forms

Loading a config that still has one of these fails. `config_normalize` (or `pom config normalize`) rewrites the ones that have a replacement.

| Removed | Write instead |
|---|---|
| `{{conn:<name>}}` | `{{shared.<name>.url}}` |
| `{{host:<name>}}`, `{{port:<name>}}` | `{{shared.<name>.host}}`, `{{shared.<name>.port}}` |
| `{{user:<name>}}`, `{{pass:<name>}}` | `{{shared.<name>.user}}`, `{{shared.<name>.pass}}` |
| `{{db:<name>}}` | `{{db.<name>}}` |
| `{{slot:<name>}}` | `{{shared.<name>.slot}}` |
| `{{var:<NAME>}}`, `{{url:...}}`, `{{ws:...}}` | No replacement: use a service ref such as `{{<repo>.<service>.url}}`. |
